data.narrative:
Furno Materials is a Seed-stage climate and energy company that has raised $11M to date. The broader Climate & Energy sector comprises nine private peers alongside one public comparable (LNZA), including later-stage companies such as Helion, Redwood Materials, QuantumScape, KoBold Metals, and Electric Hydrogen. However, a sufficiently tight peer set at the same stage and valuation tier does not exist to support a Peer-Median valuation method.

The Stage-Progression method is applicable and forms the sole quantitative foundation for this analysis. Using total capital raised ($11M) as a proxy for current valuation and applying a 2.5x multiplier typical of Seed-to-next-stage progression, this method implies a valuation of $28M. This yields a triangulated range of $23M (low) to $32M (high), with a median point of $28M.

Key uncertainties include the absence of narrow-set peer comparables at identical stage and tier, which limits cross-validation of the step-up multiplier. The Stage-Progression method's applicability depends on whether $11M in raised capital accurately reflects current equity value. Any material post-raise milestone achievement or setback would warrant recalibration. Validation through revenue multiples or cost-of-capital approaches cannot be performed without operational or financial metrics not provided here.
